name: How much does an accessible kitchen remodel cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does an accessible kitchen remodel cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an accessible kitchen remodel varies widely based on the scope of work, materials chosen, and existing kitchen layout. Minor modifications, like installing new cabinet hardware or a pull-out shelf, can be a few hundred dollars. More extensive renovations involving reconfiguring plumbing, electrical, or structural changes, along with specialized appliances, can range from $20,000 to over $75,000. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for accessible kitchen remodels vary greatly, from minor adjustments costing hundreds to extensive renovations costing $20,000 to over $75,000.
